expected_behavior: analyze.mjs reports the declared range, the installed version and every major version the upgrade crosses, and invents no breaking changes of its own.
Every breaking change in the plan cites the official upgrade guide or changelog it came from, by URL; an unsourced change is marked unknown.
Each breaking change lists where the project uses it as file:line, or says it is not used here.
The steps go one major version at a time, with the full test suite green before the next.
A missing --target/--all, or a project with no manifest the script reads, exits 1 with a message instead of proceeding.
